kind: cold startup baseline of the reading, intake and legal routes (one machine, lab throttling; not field data, not a pass/fail gate)
method: one cold fresh-context navigation per journey under the profile's CPU/network throttling and the gzip lab server, no test hook and no forced renderer; a Chromium trace (devtools.timeline, disabled-by-default-devtools.timeline, v8.execute, toplevel, blink.user_timing, loading) from before the navigation until 2000 ms after the load event; startup CPU is the top-level script work (EvaluateScript, v8.compile, FunctionCall, RunMicrotasks: evaluation and hydration) of the document's CrRendererMain thread from its navigationStart; network and idle time are not tasks and cost nothing; first-load JS is the Brotli quality 11 size of the emitted files for every script the browser requested
limitations: Tracing adds overhead to every figure; the same method must be used for any later comparison against this baseline.
Lab data on one machine: the p95 of five journeys is the largest of the five (nearest rank).
Terms does not exist yet: its comparator is Privacy.
The server charges the navigation document the profile latency; scripts are served gzip with no added latency.
